npcs.tooLowLine: You're new here — pull some turnips for me first.

teachings.line: Good work! Take this — a real fighting aura.
And learn to find your way home: Recall.

lines: The city lies east. Follow the road — and stay clear of the middle woods.
Something big prowls the dark forest.

teachings.line: Oh, all alone out here? Here, take this.

lines: The dark is only dark until you carry your own light.

npcs.tooLowLine: These old arms swung a pick for forty years.

teachings.line: Rockfalls choke the old shafts. Take my pick — swing it at the rubble.

lines: I mined that tunnel as a lad, before the spiders came up from below.
The middle road is suicide. Take the north tunnel.
Kobolds burrow south-east of here. They hoard shiny stuff, the vermin.
